messages.body: Schedule for this round. 4 traders: T1, T2, T3, T4. 5 episodes, 180s each. Within an episode there are no stages: PRODUCE, PROPOSE and APPROVE all settle for as long as the episode is open. At the bell open proposals lapse and everything held is consumed. Acknowledge with a line beginning ACK, by 07:36:35Z. Every time on this board is absolute UTC, and every tool result carries the current time as `now`: read the deadline against that, not against when this message was written. Episode 1 opens at 07:36:50Z whether or not everyone has.
